originalTitle: Qualcomm is raising phone chip prices starting September 1st

content: RAMageddon won’t be the only reason your next phone costs more — Qualcomm is about to raise prices on all its processors, as well. Qualcomm CEO Cristiano Amon said on Wednesday that “prices are going to go up” on the company’s products starting on September 1st, CNBC reports. The price hikes were rumored last week to be “a percentage in the double digits.”  Qualcomm announced the planned price increases while reporting a 20 percent year-over-year drop in revenue from its handset business, the lowest it’s reported since 2021. In its quarterly earnings presentation, Qualcomm said this drop is due to “unprecedented increases in memory pricing and supply constraints,” which have been driving up prices on everything from game consoles to laptops and even Raspberry Pi boards, with no sign of stopping any time soon. But instead of profiting less as a result, the company says it’ll raise its own prices to compensate.  [Image: https://platform.theverge.com/wp-content/uploads/sites/2/2026/07/qualcomm-handset-revenue-drop.png?quality=90&strip=all] [Image: https://platform.theverge.com/wp-content/uploads/sites/2/2026/07/qualcomm-revenue-diversification.png?quality=90&strip=all] Qualcomm is also expecting an “acceleration” in the dip in revenue from Apple products, noting that its “modem share for the upcoming iPhone launch is expected to be materially lower.” It suggested twice on the earnings call that its other businesses would make up the difference.    As smartphone revenue declines, it seems Qualcomm’s planning to become a tripod of handset, data center, and automotive — it said today that soon only half of its revenue will come from phones, and only one-third will be from phones by 2029, as its data center and automotive businesses ramp. On Wednesday, Qualcomm announced a decade-long deal to supply chips for BMW. Qualcomm EVP, CFO, and COO Akash Palkhiwala also said some OEMs are beginning to use “prior generation” Qualcomm chips in their devices in response to higher component costs.

chineseContent: RAMgeddon 不会是你的下一款手机价格上涨的唯一原因——高通也即将提高其所有处理器的价格。据 CNBC 报道，高通首席执行官克里斯蒂亚诺·阿蒙 (Cristiano Amon) 周三表示，从 9 月 1 日开始，该公司产品“价格将会上涨”。上周有传言称，价格上涨幅度为“两位数”。  高通在宣布计划提价的同时，报告其手机业务收入同比下降 20%，为 2021 年以来的最低水平。高通在季度财报中表示，这一下降是由于“内存价格空前上涨和供应限制”造成的，这些因素一直推高了从游戏机到笔记本电脑甚至树莓派主板等所有产品的价格，而且没有任何迹象表明会很快停止。但该公司表示，它不会因此而减少利润，而是会提高自己的价格来弥补。  [图片：https://platform.theverge.com/wp-content/uploads/sites/2/2026/07/qualcomm-handset-revenue-drop.png?quality=90&strip=all] [图片：https://platform.theverge.com/wp-content/uploads/sites/2/2026/07/qualcomm-revenue-diversification.png?quality=90&strip=all]高通还预计苹果产品的收入将“加速”下降，并指出“即将推出的 iPhone 的调制解调器份额预计将大幅下降”。该公司在财报电话会议上两次暗示，其他业务将弥补差额。    随着智能手机收入下降，高通似乎计划成为手机、数据中心和汽车三足鼎立——该公司今天表示，很快，其收入的一半将来自手机，随着数据中心和汽车业务的增长，到 2029 年，只有三分之一的收入将来自手机。周三，
